title: Puthoff and Davis never shown AARO notes of their interviews

tellings.quote: I mean I think uh Hal Putoff and Eric Davis to this day have never been shown the notes from their meetings with Arrow.

plain: Two scientists, Harold Puthoff and Eric W. Davis, met with AARO, the Pentagon office set up in 2022 to look into unexplained sightings, and to this day have never been shown the notes taken at those meetings. A former Senate staffer named Kurt McConnell says so, passing it on as something he knows of the two men, which would mean the office kept its own record of their accounts out of their sight.
